name: RankRowsNode
label: Rank Rows
description: Adds a column with the rank of rows within partitions based on an ordering column. Supports ascending/descending order and dense or standard ranking.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to rank rows for.

fields.name: OrderByColumn
fields.label: Order By Column
fields.description: The column used to determine the ranking order.

fields.name: Ascending
fields.label: Ascending
fields.description: True to rank in ascending order, false for descending. Defaults to true.

fields.name: DenseRank
fields.label: Dense Rank
fields.description: True to use dense ranking (no gaps), false for standard ranking (gaps). Defaults to false.

fields.name: PartitionByColumns
fields.label: Partition By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns that define partitions. Ranking restarts per partition.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the rank column. Defaults to 'Rank'.
